given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception such as a damaged package
given_when_then.when: The system processes the delivery proof
given_when_then.then: A Dispute Ticket is automatically generated with status 'Open' and linked to the associated Order Request

given_when_then.given: A Customer reports a missing item and the system detects the delivery proof is missing or incomplete
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to generate a Dispute Ticket
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket with status 'Pending Investigation' and notifies the Customer

given_when_then.given: A decision is recorded for an active Dispute Ticket
given_when_then.when: The system updates the ticket status
given_when_then.then: The Dispute Ticket status transitions from 'Open' to 'Resolved'

given_when_then.given: A Financial Transaction Record is associated with the Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Dispute Ticket status is not yet 'Resolved'
given_when_then.then: The Financial adjustments cannot be finalized

success_criteria: A Dispute Ticket is created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception
The Dispute Ticket remains permanently linked to the original Order Request throughout the resolution process
The Dispute Ticket status changes to 'Resolved' only after a final decision is recorded
Financial adjustments are blocked until the Dispute Ticket is marked as Resolved
